about: P1 Explain's blind held-out set (PHASE8_PLAN 15.12's adoption bar: measured on the main set and a blind held-out set written before any run; 18.3: held-out sets grow toward about 30 cases, written blind, never tuned on). Its first case is the second alert of the operator's Walk 2 (2026-10-27), its pack rebuilt from the alert history with pack schema 5 (C1849 to C1851), so the rebuilt path is measured on a set no prompt was written against; the main set's case 21 is the walk's first alert, rebuilt the same way. Each expectation is set from its pack's evidence before any run, and says why; cases.explain_unready says first whether the pack holds what the case is judged on, then cases.explain_misses judges the answer on structured fields. A case is recorded only when a version is measured on this set; none has been.

cases.name: Walk 2's second alert, its pack rebuilt from the alert history: s1 unreachable by SNMP at 17:00 on 2026-10-22, while scrapes failed on every device around it and SNMP alerts went pending across the fleet; a cause shared beneath them, never s1's own

rebuilt.how: evidence_pack.build_for_episode (Build evidence), pack schema 5: the other alerts in the window, every id the network model's, the health figures for the devices within two hops in the model as it is now. The walk's stored pack (schema 4, hash 69441dbc9f29) stays frozen; a case's runs ask a pack rebuilt with schema 5 and saved by scripts/nmas-pack-replay --episode.

cases.found: the pack rebuilt with schema 5 on the host (2026-10-27 01:39 UTC, read-only, nothing kept, no call): s1 CPU 38 to 41%, 3 heartbeats (the longest gap 326 s, the last 169 s before the alert), 6 of 34 scrapes failed 16:44:18 to 17:00:18, discards 0, no log line; within two hops in the model as now r1 failed 11 of 119 scrapes, r3 10, r2 5, r4 5, s3 4, s2 1, s4 1; the other alerts (26 in the window): Device unreachable (SNMP) pending and resolved on r1, r3, r4, r6, r7 and s3 between 16:44:50 and 16:59:50, an earlier episode of s1's own at 16:45:50, IP SLA probe failing on r1, r4 and s2, output discards on one polled address firing.
cases.why: Set from the evidence before any run (2026-10-27): s1 sent its heartbeats on time at ordinary CPU and logged nothing, so its own figures do not explain an SNMP outage; scrapes failed on every device within two hops through the same 17 minutes, and SNMP alerts went pending on six other devices in it, so a cause shared beneath them (the polling path, or the host they share) is the evidence's, offered as a hypothesis a person must confirm, cited by the figures of three or more devices or by the alerts of three or more.
cases.flag: A person reads the recording: the shared cause is placed beneath the devices, hedged as not in the evidence; s1's brief alert is not blamed on s1 itself; no figure is stated the pack does not hold.
